hook: First-time young drug users can skip prosecution after *7-8 days* of counselling
hook_b: First-time young drug users can skip prosecution after *7-8 days* of counselling
tldr: Hyderabad CP Mahesh Muralidhar Bhagwat asked Old City religious elders to help curb drug abuse among youth and explained the Section 64A NDPS option for first-time users.

beats.what: At Kotwal House, Purani Haveli, the Police Commissioner met religious elders and peace committee members on communal harmony and drug abuse among Old City youth.
beats.why: He flagged schoolchildren's and youth's growing vulnerability to narcotics and misuse of social media, and asked elders to use sermons and gatherings to warn families.
beats.care: Under Section 64A of the NDPS Act, eligible youngsters and parents get 7-8 days of counselling and can be exempted from prosecution if later blood tests are negative.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Tips on drug activity: helpline 1908, Dial 112 or Dial 100. He also warned against reposting old videos of resolved incidents, and said a job mela with private firms is planned.

cards.q: For first-time young drug users: counselling instead of prosecution?

qs: Who decides which youngsters are 'eligible' for the counselling route?
How will the police measure if Mission Chabutra works?

facts.t: Residents can report drug activity on *3* numbers: 1908, 112 and 100.

viz.l: The Section 64A route for first-time users

steps.e: Negative test: can be exempted from prosecution

viz.verdict: How the counselling option works for eligible first-time youth, as the Commissioner described.

learn.t: NDPS Act = Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, India's main drug law; Section 64A gives immunity to addicts who volunteer for treatment.

watch: Expansion of Mission Chabutra and action on elders' requests on late-night shop timings.

sources.name: Telangana Today
sources.title: Hyderabad Police Commissioner seeks support to curb drug abuse in Old City

fact: First-time young drug users can avoid prosecution after *7-8 days* of de-addiction counselling
twist: Mission Chabutra, which counsels youngsters found loitering late at night, is being *expanded*, the Commissioner said.
